turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    C --> C1[Run Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    C1 --> C2[Compress to floor residue]
    C2 --> C3[Name evaporated content and function]
    C3 --> C4[Locate operative sentence]
    C4 --> C5[Report ratio, erosion direction, and rough-edge flag]
    C5 --> C6[This is a finding, not a draft.]
    C6 --> Z[Stop]

    B -->|Draft prompt| D[PROVIDE]
    D --> E{Mode stated or inferable?}
    E -->|No| E1[Ask for mode]
    E1 --> E
    E -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| F[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    F -->|HUMAN| F1[Run the speak test]
    F -->|No gaps| G[Compress the prompt]
    F -->|Gaps| F2{How many gaps?}
    F2 -->|Three or fewer| F3[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    F2 -->|Four or more| F4[Ask three largest questions]
    F4 --> F5[Assume the remaining gaps]
    F3 --> F6[Wait for the answer]
    F5 --> F6
    F6 --> F
    F1 --> G

    G --> H{Did the cut remove specification?}
    H -->|Yes| H1[Name the failure and revert]
    H1 --> G
    H -->|No| I{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    I -->|Yes| J[Contract is minimal]
    I -->|No| K{Floor still passes?}
    K -->|No| K1[Return the last passing version]
    K1 --> J
    K -->|Yes| G
    J --> L[Output the optimized prompt]
    L --> M[Cut line]
    M --> N[Note or Assume lines as needed]
    N --> O[Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?]

    O -->|Keep negotiating| G
    O -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| P{Execution tools available?}
    P -->|No| P1[Gate stays closed]
    P1 --> Z
    P -->|Yes| Q[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    Q --> R[Execute exactly as written]
    R --> S{Result}
    S -->|Success| Z
    S -->|Floor item fails| T[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    T --> G
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: H1 -> G, K -> G
